<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead">
You are a research agent on a team building a Max4Live recreation of the Intellijel Metropolix sequencer. Your task is to research MOD LANES, ASSIGNABLE OUTPUTS, and INTERNAL MODULATION ROUTING.

READ THE PDF at /Users/user1303836/Development/maxmsp-utils/metropolix_menu.pdf - read pages 90-130. Also scan other sections for mod lane references. The PDF is 193 pages.

Focus on documenting:
1. The 8 mod lanes - each has 8 stages of stored values
2. Per-mod-lane settings: independent playback order, sequence length, clock division
3. Mod lane routing destinations - the full list of internal parameters that can be modulated
4. Assignable outputs A and B - what they can output, voltage ranges (translate to MIDI/parameter ranges)
5. How mod lane values are applied to their targets (additive? multiplicative? replacement?)
6. Mod lane value ranges and resolution
7. How mod lanes clock independently from the main sequencer
8. Any mod lane interactions or chaining

For M4L implementation: mod lanes that target internal parameters are straightforward (internal modulation). Mod lanes routed to outputs A/B should use live.remote~ for parameter mapping. Document the full modulation destination list carefully.

Write your findings to /Users/user1303836/Development/maxmsp-utils/.research/04_modlanes.md

After writing your file, mark task #4 as completed, then read ALL other research files in /Users/user1303836/Development/maxmsp-utils/.research/ and send a message to "plan-writer" with a summary of your findings and any cross-cutting concerns.
</teammate-message>
